messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Saturday 7 Feb
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The firm's DMS will be unavailable from 22:00 on Saturday 7 February to 06:00 Sunday 8 February for a scheduled storage upgrade. Please check in any documents before 21:00 Saturday. Outlook and email are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
